scope: Possessory title, adverse possession of registered land, and first registration by possession

procedural_sources.finding: Registered-land adverse possession applications use the statutory application route and require evidence of the facts relied upon.
Current guidance provides separate material for adverse possession and possessory-title applications.

case_law.scope: Adverse possession/title by possession; full proposition extraction remains required.

critical_distinctions: First registration with possessory title is distinct from acquisition of registered land by possession.
The statutory limitation question is distinct from the registration/procedure question.
Prescription of easements is distinct from acquisition of title by possession.
Historical possession claims require the law applicable at the relevant time.
blocking_reasons: Complete proposition-level extraction from the relevant primary judgment(s).
Complete historical/transitional analysis for the relevant possession date.
Complete current form/rule mapping for every possessory-title user route.
guardrails: No claim that a limitation period alone guarantees registration.
